title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-2281 located at 12870 West Walsh Avenue, easterly of Beethoven…
text:
[Council File 26-1659; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-2281 located at 12870 West Walsh Avenue, easterly of Beethoven Street.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2025-2281 located at 12870 West Walsh Avenue, easterly of Beethoven Street.
Owner: Hallie & Joseph Perez (A)(O); Surveyor: Peter Riechers
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064.00 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council would approve the final parcel map for 12870 West Walsh Avenue in Council District 11.
